title: Painting Your Bedroom in GTA 6 Makes Lucia Like You More 🎨 #Shorts
description:
In GTA 6 you can pick paint colors and roll them onto your bedroom walls yourself, and it boosts your relationship with Lucia. You can paint the whole inside of Jason's home. Game Informer's editor even fixed the roof, a leak and the stairs. And one streamer painted for 40 minutes, then started over because blue "makes me look like a kid."

Sources:
